title: Which Was the King?
author: James Baldwin
summary: 亨利四世让路边男孩猜谁是国王，男孩说戴帽子的不是你就是我。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1912 by the American Book Company; author James Baldwin (1841–1925). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: One day King Henry the Fourth of France was hunting in a large forest. Towards evening he told his men to ride home by the main road while he went by another way that was somewhat longer.
paragraphs.zh: 一天，法国国王亨利四世在一片大森林里打猎。傍晚时，他让随从们走大路回去，自己走另一条稍远的路。

paragraphs.en: As he came out of the forest he saw a little boy by the roadside, who seemed to be watching for some one.
paragraphs.zh: 他走出森林时，看见路边有个小男孩，似乎在等什么人。

paragraphs.en: "Well, my boy," said the king, "are you looking for your father?"
paragraphs.zh: “喂，孩子，”国王说，“你在等你父亲吗？”

paragraphs.en: "No, sir," answered the boy. "I am looking for the king. They say he is hunting in the woods, and perhaps will ride out this way. So I'm waiting to see him."
paragraphs.zh: “不是，先生，”男孩回答，“我在等国王。听说他在林子里打猎，也许会从这条路出来。所以我在这儿等着看他。”

paragraphs.en: "Oh, if that is what you wish," said King Henry, "get up behind me on the horse and I'll take you to the place where you will see him."
paragraphs.zh: “哦，原来你想见他，”亨利国王说，“那就上马坐到我后面来，我带你到能看见他的地方去。”

paragraphs.en: The boy got up at once, and sat behind the king. The horse cantered briskly along, and king and boy were soon quite well acquainted.
paragraphs.zh: 男孩立刻爬上马，坐在国王身后。马轻快地小跑起来，国王和男孩很快就熟络了。

paragraphs.en: "They say that King Henry always has a number of men with him," said the boy; "how shall I know which is he?"
paragraphs.zh: “听说亨利国王身边总有许多人，”男孩说，“我怎么知道哪一个是国王呢？”

paragraphs.en: "Oh, that will be easy enough," was the answer. "All the other men will take off their hats, but the king will keep his on."
paragraphs.zh: “哦，那可容易了，”国王回答，“别的人都会脱下帽子，只有国王会戴着。”

paragraphs.en: "Do you mean that the one with his hat on will be the king?"
paragraphs.zh: “您的意思是，戴着帽子的那一个就是国王？”

paragraphs.en: Soon they came into the main road where a number of the king's men were waiting. All the men seemed amused when they saw the boy, and as they rode up, they greeted the king by taking off their hats.
paragraphs.zh: 不久，他们来到大路上，那里有一群国王的随从在等候。众人看见男孩都觉得有趣；他们骑马迎上来时，都脱下帽子向国王致意。

paragraphs.en: "Well, my boy," said King Henry, "which do you think is the king?"
paragraphs.zh: “那么，孩子，”亨利国王说，“你觉得哪一个是国王？”

paragraphs.en: "I don't know," answered the boy; "but it must be either you or I, for we both have our hats on."
paragraphs.zh: “我不知道，”男孩回答，“不过一定是你或者我，因为我们两个都戴着帽子。”
